title: Marlins Boating & Fishing Day
description: We are thrilled to be part of this incredible event as one of the sponsors of Boating & Fishing Day, at loanDepot Park on Sunday, August 11...
html:
We are thrilled to be part of this incredible event as one of the sponsors of Boating & Fishing Day, taking place at loanDepot Park on Sunday, August 11, at 12:40 PM, where the Miami Marlins will be taking on the San Diego Padres!

Join us for an exciting day of baseball, boating, and fishing fun! This special ticket package includes a limited-edition Marlins Boating & Fishing Day Hat, making it a perfect keepsake for fans of both sports and outdoor adventures.

The festivities kick off at 11:30 AM in the West Plaza, where various boating brands and companies, including ours, will be showcasing their latest models and services. Whether you’re an avid boater or just curious about the latest in marine technology, there’s something for everyone!

Don’t miss out on this fantastic opportunity to enjoy a day at the ballpark while exploring the latest in boating and fishing. We’re happy that the Miami Marlins invited us to be part of this exciting day, and we can’t wait to see you there!
